decisive_items: lesion filled the foramen of Magendie, exerted mass effect on the medulla
elevated choline peak and reduced N-acetyl aspartate signal
response.rationale: Medulloblastoma is favored by the vermian location, DWI hyperintensity (high cellularity), MRS choline/NAA pattern, and absence of edema/hemorrhage; pilocytic astrocytoma is less likely due to typical cystic enhancement and lower DWI signal.

rejected.why: Pilocytic astrocytoma usually shows cystic components and less restricted diffusion; DWI hyperintensity and MRS pattern favor medulloblastoma.
Hemangioblastoma typically has hemorrhage/calcification or cystic mural nodule; GRE T2* showed no hemorrhage/calcification, making it less likely.
Cerebellar astrocytoma is a broad category; lacks specific features like DWI restriction and MRS pattern.
Cerebellar hemangioblastoma is contradicted by absence of hemorrhage/calcification and typical imaging features.
